project_type: React 18 + Vite 6 + TypeScript SPA with dark spatial glassmorphism UI
build_system: Vite 6 with pnpm (but pnpm not installed in sandbox - use bun as runtime for build/install)
test_framework: No test framework configured (no test files in project)
build_command: bun run build (runs tsc -b && vite build)
verification_instructions: Run bun run build and confirm zero TypeScript errors and successful Vite build output
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node/pnpm not installed - use bun (1.2.14) as package manager and runtime. node_modules already exists from prior phases.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode, no mock data in final CRM pages, all data from Supabase hooks
key_patterns: Services in src/services/<domain>/ with barrel index.ts and types.ts. Hooks in src/hooks/use<Entity>.ts using @tanstack/react-query with supabase client from @/lib/supabase. Pages use motion/react for animations, shadcn-style UI components from @/components/ui/. Sidebar uses navSections array in src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx. Routes defined in src/App.tsx with lazy imports. Existing CRM hooks: useLeads, useDeals, useCustomers, useActivities. sonner for toast notifications.
directory_structure: src/pages/crm/ (CRM page components), src/hooks/ (TanStack Query hooks), src/services/ (service layers per domain), src/types/ (TypeScript interfaces), src/components/ui/ (shadcn primitives), src/components/shared/ (reusable composed components), src/components/layout/ (AppShell, Sidebar, TopNav), supabase/migrations/ (SQL migrations)
